name: MK Website Assistant
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Done-for-you AI assistant for small business websites from UK studio MK Spark Interactive: answers visitors from approved information, emails you every enquiry and can take appointment requests.
best_for: small UK service businesses such as dental and physio practices, vets, opticians and letting agents that want an AI assistant set up for them on their website to answer enquiries and capture leads after hours
skip_if: you want to build and tune a chatbot yourself, need automatic booking, or want a large vendor with a published support structure
honest_knock: It is a service from a small studio rather than software you configure yourself, so you depend on the founder for set-up and changes. Prices are "from" amounts, so the final set-up fee can be higher. Plus sends appointment requests for you to confirm; it does not book automatically. The same site also sells games, apps and developer tools, which makes it less focused than a dedicated chatbot vendor.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-03 on mksparkinteractive.com, in pounds sterling) MK Website Assistant is a done-for-you service from MK Spark Interactive, a small UK studio, not a self-serve app. The AI Website Assistant, added to your existing website, costs from £290 to set up, with the first month included, and then £39 a month, cancel anytime. AI Assistant Plus also costs from £290 and then £59 a month; it adds appointment requests in the chat and removes the "Powered by" line. If you need a new website too, the Website + 24/7 AI Agent package costs from £1,800, with the first 3 months of hosting and updates included and then £69 a month. The site says founding clients get the monthly price fixed for 12 months (and Plus features free for 3 months). The prices are "from" amounts; the site promises fixed prices and a live demo before you pay.

schema_offer.description: AI Website Assistant, monthly fee after a one-off set-up from £290 (first month included), cancel anytime; Plus with appointment requests £59 a month; website plus assistant from £1,800, then £69 a month. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-03.

compare_with.name: Jotform AI Agents
compare_with.why: Jotform AI Agents is in our dossiers as a do-it-yourself AI agent builder: on 24 September 2026 its Starter plan was free for 5 agents and 100 conversations a month, with Bronze at $34 a month billed annually. MK Website Assistant is done for you: the studio sets it up and you approve the answers, for £290 plus £39 a month
